description: This file defines the ShowsService class which provides mock data for OTT categories and generates dynamic poster URLs based on incoming requests. It includes methods to retrieve category-specific show data with URLs constructed dynamically.

classes.name: ShowsService
classes.description: Service that returns mock OTT categories and maps image filenames, generating dynamic poster URLs based on request.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the array for a given category with dynamic poster URLs.
